label: UserDownloads
comment: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].
enriched_comment: An outdated type representing a user's interaction of downloading content. Also called user download, content download, file retrieval. Examples: a user downloading a software update, downloading an e-book, saving an image from a website.
embedding_text: UserDownloads (Thing > Event > UserInteraction): An outdated type representing a user's interaction of downloading content. Also called user download, content download, file retrieval.

label: UserInteraction
comment: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].
enriched_comment: An outdated general type representing any interaction a user has with a web page or content. Also called user activity, user engagement, web interaction. Examples: a user clicking a link, submitting a form, scrolling a page.
embedding_text: UserInteraction (Thing > Event): An outdated general type representing any interaction a user has with a web page or content. Also called user activity, user engagement, web interaction.

label: UserLikes
comment: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].
enriched_comment: An outdated type representing a user's interaction of expressing approval or liking for content. Also called user like, content like, approval. Examples: a user liking a photo on social media, giving a thumbs-up to a video, favoriting an item.
embedding_text: UserLikes (Thing > Event > UserInteraction): An outdated type representing a user's interaction of expressing approval or liking for content. Also called user like, content like, approval.

label: UserPageVisits
comment: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].
enriched_comment: An outdated type representing a user's interaction of visiting a web page. Also called page view, web visit, browsing activity. Examples: a user navigating to a product page, visiting a news article, browsing a website.
embedding_text: UserPageVisits (Thing > Event > UserInteraction): An outdated type representing a user's interaction of visiting a web page. Also called page view, web visit, browsing activity.

label: UserPlays
comment: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].
enriched_comment: An outdated type representing a user's interaction of playing media content. Also called user play, media playback, content viewing. Examples: a user playing a video, listening to an audio track, starting a game.
embedding_text: UserPlays (Thing > Event > UserInteraction): An outdated type representing a user's interaction of playing media content. Also called user play, media playback, content viewing.

label: UserPlusOnes
comment: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].
enriched_comment: An outdated type representing a user's interaction of giving a "+1" endorsement, typically on Google+ or similar platforms. Also called user endorsement, +1, social recommendation. Examples: a user giving a +1 to a web page, endorsing a business, recommending content.
embedding_text: UserPlusOnes (Thing > Event > UserInteraction): An outdated type representing a user's interaction of giving a "+1" endorsement, typically on Google+ or similar platforms. Also called user endorsement, +1, social recommendation.

label: UserReview
comment: A review created by an end-user (e.g. consumer, purchaser, attendee etc.), in contrast with [[CriticReview]].
enriched_comment: A review or critique created by an end-user, such as a consumer or attendee, rather than a professional critic. Also called customer review, consumer feedback, public review. Examples: a customer's product review on an e-commerce site, a diner's restaurant review, an audience member's movie review. Distinct from CriticReview, which is a review written by a professional critic.
embedding_text: UserReview (Thing > CreativeWork > Review): A review or critique created by an end-user, such as a consumer or attendee, rather than a professional critic. Also called customer review, consumer feedback, public review.

label: UserTweets
comment: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].
enriched_comment: An outdated type representing a user's interaction of posting a tweet on Twitter. Also called user tweet, microblog post, social media update. Examples: a user posting a message on Twitter, sharing a link via tweet, replying to another tweet.
embedding_text: UserTweets (Thing > Event > UserInteraction): An outdated type representing a user's interaction of posting a tweet on Twitter. Also called user tweet, microblog post, social media update.

label: VacationRental
comment: A kind of lodging business that focuses on renting single properties for limited time.
enriched_comment: A lodging business that offers single properties for rent for limited periods, typically for vacations. Also called holiday rental, short-term rental, vacation home. Examples: an Airbnb apartment, a beach house rental, a cabin in the mountains.
embedding_text: VacationRental (Thing > Organization > LocalBusiness > LodgingBusiness): A lodging business that offers single properties for rent for limited periods, typically for vacations. Also called holiday rental, short-term rental, vacation home.

label: Vehicle
comment: A vehicle is a device that is designed or used to transport people or cargo over land, water, air, or through space.
enriched_comment: A device designed or used for transporting people or cargo across various environments. Also called conveyance, transport, automobile. Examples: a car, a bicycle, an airplane, a boat, a truck.
embedding_text: Vehicle (Thing > Product): A device designed or used for transporting people or cargo across various environments. Also called conveyance, transport, automobile.

label: Vein
comment: A type of blood vessel that specifically carries blood to the heart.
enriched_comment: A type of blood vessel specifically responsible for carrying deoxygenated blood back towards the heart. Also called blood vein, venule, vena. Examples: the jugular vein, the femoral vein, the pulmonary vein.
embedding_text: Vein (Thing > MedicalEntity > AnatomicalStructure > Vessel): A type of blood vessel specifically responsible for carrying deoxygenated blood back towards the heart. Also called blood vein, venule, vena.

label: Vessel
comment: A component of the human body circulatory system comprised of an intricate network of hollow tubes that transport blood throughout the entire body.
enriched_comment: A component of the circulatory system, comprising hollow tubes that transport blood throughout the body. Also called blood vessel, circulatory tube, vascular conduit. Examples: an artery, a vein, a capillary.
embedding_text: Vessel (Thing > MedicalEntity > AnatomicalStructure): A component of the circulatory system, comprising hollow tubes that transport blood throughout the body. Also called blood vessel, circulatory tube, vascular conduit.

label: VeterinaryCare
comment: A vet's office.
enriched_comment: A local business or organization providing medical services for animals. Also called vet clinic, animal hospital, veterinary practice. Examples: a local veterinary office, an emergency animal hospital, a mobile vet service.
embedding_text: VeterinaryCare (Thing > Organization > MedicalOrganization): A local business or organization providing medical services for animals. Also called vet clinic, animal hospital, veterinary practice.

label: VideoGallery
comment: Web page type: Video gallery page.
enriched_comment: A web page designed to display a collection of video content. Also called video collection page, media gallery, video archive. Examples: a YouTube channel page, a news website's video section, a personal video portfolio.
embedding_text: VideoGallery (Thing > CreativeWork > WebPage > CollectionPage > MediaGallery): A web page designed to display a collection of video content. Also called video collection page, media gallery, video archive.

label: VideoGame
comment: A video game is an electronic game that involves human interaction with a user interface to generate visual feedback on a video device.
enriched_comment: An electronic game that involves human interaction with a user interface to generate visual feedback on a video device. Also called computer game, console game, digital game. Examples: Super Mario Bros., The Legend of Zelda, Call of Duty.
embedding_text: VideoGame (Thing > CreativeWork > Game): An electronic game that involves human interaction with a user interface to generate visual feedback on a video device. Also called computer game, console game, digital game.

label: VideoGameClip
comment: A short segment/part of a video game.
enriched_comment: A short segment or part of a video game, often used for promotional or highlight purposes. Also called game clip, gameplay footage, video game segment. Examples: a highlight reel from an e-sports match, a trailer showing a game's cutscene, a short recording of a player's achievement.
embedding_text: VideoGameClip (Thing > CreativeWork > Clip): A short segment or part of a video game, often used for promotional or highlight purposes. Also called game clip, gameplay footage, video game segment.

label: VideoGameSeries
comment: A video game series.
enriched_comment: A sequence of related video games, often sharing a common storyline, characters, or gameplay mechanics. Also called game franchise, video game saga, game series. Examples: The Final Fantasy series, The Elder Scrolls series, Grand Theft Auto series.
embedding_text: VideoGameSeries (Thing > CreativeWork > CreativeWorkSeries): A sequence of related video games, often sharing a common storyline, characters, or gameplay mechanics. Also called game franchise, video game saga, game series.

label: VideoObject
comment: A video file.
enriched_comment: A media object representing a video file. Also called video file, digital video, movie clip. Examples: an MP4 video, a YouTube video, a short film.
embedding_text: VideoObject (Thing > CreativeWork > MediaObject): A media object representing a video file. Also called video file, digital video, movie clip.

label: VideoObjectSnapshot
comment: A specific and exact (byte-for-byte) version of a [[VideoObject]]. Two byte-for-byte identical files, for the purposes of this type, considered identical. If they have different embedded metadata the files will differ. Different external facts about the files, e.g. creator or dateCreated that aren't represented in their actual content, do not affect this notion of identity.
enriched_comment: A specific, byte-for-byte identical version of a video file. Also called exact video copy, identical video file, video instance. Examples: a specific version of a movie file, a particular encoding of a video, a digital master copy of a video.
embedding_text: VideoObjectSnapshot (Thing > CreativeWork > MediaObject > VideoObject): A specific, byte-for-byte identical version of a video file. Also called exact video copy, identical video file, video instance.

label: ViewAction
comment: The act of consuming static visual content.
enriched_comment: The act of consuming or perceiving static visual content. Also called look at, observe, gaze upon. Examples: viewing a photograph, looking at a painting, examining a diagram.
embedding_text: ViewAction (Thing > Action > ConsumeAction): The act of consuming or perceiving static visual content. Also called look at, observe, gaze upon.

label: VirtualLocation
comment: An online or virtual location for attending events. For example, one may attend an online seminar or educational event. While a virtual location may be used as the location of an event, virtual locations should not be confused with physical locations in the real world.
enriched_comment: An online or non-physical location where events can be attended, such as a webinar or online meeting. Also called online venue, remote location, digital space. Examples: a Zoom meeting room, a webinar platform, a virtual conference hall.
embedding_text: VirtualLocation (Thing > Intangible): An online or non-physical location where events can be attended, such as a webinar or online meeting. Also called online venue, remote location, digital space.

label: VisualArtsEvent
comment: Event type: Visual arts event.
enriched_comment: An event related to visual arts, such as an exhibition, gallery opening, or art fair. Also called art exhibition, gallery event, visual art show. Examples: a painting exhibition, a sculpture display, a photography festival.
embedding_text: VisualArtsEvent (Thing > Event): An event related to visual arts, such as an exhibition, gallery opening, or art fair. Also called art exhibition, gallery event, visual art show.

label: VisualArtwork
comment: A work of art that is primarily visual in character.
enriched_comment: A creative work that is primarily visual in nature, such as a painting, sculpture, or photograph. Also called art piece, visual art, artwork. Examples: Leonardo da Vinci's Mona Lisa, a Rodin sculpture, an Ansel Adams photograph.
embedding_text: VisualArtwork (Thing > CreativeWork): A creative work that is primarily visual in nature, such as a painting, sculpture, or photograph. Also called art piece, visual art, artwork.

label: VitalSign
comment: Vital signs are measures of various physiological functions in order to assess the most basic body functions.
enriched_comment: A measurable physiological function used to assess the most basic body functions and overall health. Also called physiological sign, health indicator, body function measure. Examples: body temperature, heart rate, blood pressure, respiratory rate.
embedding_text: VitalSign (Thing > MedicalEntity > MedicalCondition > MedicalSignOrSymptom > MedicalSign): A measurable physiological function used to assess the most basic body functions and overall health. Also called physiological sign, health indicator, body function measure.

label: Volcano
comment: A volcano, like Fujisan.
enriched_comment: A landform, typically a mountain, with a vent through which lava, rock fragments, hot vapor, and gas are ejected. Also called active volcano, dormant volcano, volcanic mountain. Examples: Mount Fuji, Mount Vesuvius, Kilauea.
embedding_text: Volcano (Thing > Place > Landform): A landform, typically a mountain, with a vent through which lava, rock fragments, hot vapor, and gas are ejected. Also called active volcano, dormant volcano, volcanic mountain.

label: VoteAction
comment: The act of expressing a preference from a fixed/finite/structured set of choices/options.
enriched_comment: The act of expressing a preference or choice from a predefined set of options. Also called casting a vote, ballot, election. Examples: voting in a political election, casting a vote for a competition winner, participating in a poll.
embedding_text: VoteAction (Thing > Action > AssessAction > ChooseAction): The act of expressing a preference or choice from a predefined set of options. Also called casting a vote, ballot, election.

label: WPAdBlock
comment: An advertising section of the page.
enriched_comment: A specific section of a web page dedicated to displaying advertisements. Also called ad unit, advertising block, banner ad section. Examples: a banner ad at the top of a page, a sidebar ad, an interstitial ad space.
embedding_text: WPAdBlock (Thing > CreativeWork > WebPageElement): A specific section of a web page dedicated to displaying advertisements. Also called ad unit, advertising block, banner ad section.

label: WPFooter
comment: The footer section of the page.
enriched_comment: The bottom section of a web page, typically containing copyright information, contact details, and navigation links. Also called page footer, website footer, site bottom. Examples: the copyright notice at the bottom of a website, links to privacy policy and terms of service, social media icons in the footer.
embedding_text: WPFooter (Thing > CreativeWork > WebPageElement): The bottom section of a web page, typically containing copyright information, contact details, and navigation links. Also called page footer, website footer, site bottom.

label: WPHeader
comment: The header section of the page.
enriched_comment: The top section of a web page, typically containing the site's logo, main navigation, and branding elements. Also called page header, website header, site top. Examples: a website's logo and main menu bar, a search bar at the top of a page, a site title.
embedding_text: WPHeader (Thing > CreativeWork > WebPageElement): The top section of a web page, typically containing the site's logo, main navigation, and branding elements. Also called page header, website header, site top.

label: WPSideBar
comment: A sidebar section of the page.
enriched_comment: A section of a web page positioned to the side of the main content, often used for navigation, advertisements, or supplementary information. Also called page sidebar, side panel, auxiliary column. Examples: a navigation menu on the left side of a blog, a list of related articles in a right sidebar, an ad column.
embedding_text: WPSideBar (Thing > CreativeWork > WebPageElement): A section of a web page positioned to the side of the main content, often used for navigation, advertisements, or supplementary information. Also called page sidebar, side panel, auxiliary column.

label: WantAction
comment: The act of expressing a desire about the object. An agent wants an object.
enriched_comment: The act of expressing a desire or wish for an object or outcome. Also called desire, wish for, covet. Examples: wanting a new car, desiring a specific job, wishing for peace.
embedding_text: WantAction (Thing > Action > AssessAction > ReactAction): The act of expressing a desire or wish for an object or outcome. Also called desire, wish for, covet.

label: WarrantyPromise
comment: A structured value representing the duration and scope of services that will be provided to a customer free of charge in case of a defect or malfunction of a product.
enriched_comment: A structured value representing the duration and scope of free services provided for a product's defects or malfunctions. Also called product warranty, guarantee, service promise. Examples: a 1-year manufacturer's warranty, a 90-day repair guarantee, a lifetime parts warranty.
embedding_text: WarrantyPromise (Thing > Intangible > StructuredValue): A structured value representing the duration and scope of free services provided for a product's defects or malfunctions. Also called product warranty, guarantee, service promise.

label: WarrantyScope
comment:
A range of services that will be provided to a customer free of charge in case of a defect or malfunction of a product.

Commonly used values:

* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#Labor-BringIn
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#PartsAndLabor-BringIn
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#PartsAndLabor-PickUp
enriched_comment: An enumeration describing the range of services covered by a warranty in case of product defect or malfunction. Also called warranty coverage, guarantee scope, service level. Examples: "Parts and Labor - Bring In", "Labor - On Site", "Parts Only".
embedding_text: WarrantyScope (Thing > Intangible > Enumeration): An enumeration describing the range of services covered by a warranty in case of product defect or malfunction. Also called warranty coverage, guarantee scope, service level.

label: WatchAction
comment: The act of consuming dynamic/moving visual content.
enriched_comment: The act of consuming dynamic or moving visual content. Also called view, observe, see. Examples: watching a movie, watching a live sports broadcast, watching a video tutorial.
embedding_text: WatchAction (Thing > Action > ConsumeAction): The act of consuming dynamic or moving visual content. Also called view, observe, see.

label: Waterfall
comment: A waterfall, like Niagara.
enriched_comment: A landform where water flows over a vertical drop or a series of steep drops in the course of a stream or river. Also called cascade, falls, cataract. Examples: Niagara Falls, Victoria Falls, Angel Falls.
embedding_text: Waterfall (Thing > Place > Landform > BodyOfWater): A landform where water flows over a vertical drop or a series of steep drops in the course of a stream or river. Also called cascade, falls, cataract.

label: WearAction
comment: The act of dressing oneself in clothing.
enriched_comment: The act of dressing oneself in clothing or accessories. Also called put on, don, attire oneself. Examples: wearing a coat, putting on shoes, wearing a hat.
embedding_text: WearAction (Thing > Action > ConsumeAction > UseAction): The act of dressing oneself in clothing or accessories. Also called put on, don, attire oneself.

label: WearableMeasurementTypeEnumeration
comment: Enumerates common types of measurement for wearables products.
enriched_comment: An enumeration of common measurement types used for wearable products. Also called wearable sizing type, apparel measurement, garment dimension. Examples: "chest circumference", "sleeve length", "inseam".
embedding_text: WearableMeasurementTypeEnumeration (Thing > Intangible > Enumeration > MeasurementTypeEnumeration): An enumeration of common measurement types used for wearable products. Also called wearable sizing type, apparel measurement, garment dimension.

label: WearableSizeGroupEnumeration
comment: Enumerates common size groups (also known as "size types") for wearable products.
enriched_comment: An enumeration of common size groups or types for wearable products. Also called apparel size group, clothing size type, garment category. Examples: "men's", "women's", "children's", "unisex".
embedding_text: WearableSizeGroupEnumeration (Thing > Intangible > Enumeration > SizeGroupEnumeration): An enumeration of common size groups or types for wearable products. Also called apparel size group, clothing size type, garment category.

label: WearableSizeSystemEnumeration
comment: Enumerates common size systems specific for wearable products.
enriched_comment: An enumeration of common sizing systems specific to wearable products. Also called apparel sizing system, clothing size standard, garment measurement standard. Examples: "US size system", "EU size system", "UK size system".
embedding_text: WearableSizeSystemEnumeration (Thing > Intangible > Enumeration > SizeSystemEnumeration): An enumeration of common sizing systems specific to wearable products. Also called apparel sizing system, clothing size standard, garment measurement standard.

label: WebAPI
comment: An application programming interface accessible over Web/Internet technologies.
enriched_comment: An application programming interface that is accessible over web or internet technologies. Also called web service, API, REST API. Examples: the Google Maps API, the Twitter API, a weather data API.
embedding_text: WebAPI (Thing > Intangible > Service): An application programming interface that is accessible over web or internet technologies. Also called web service, API, REST API.

label: WebApplication
comment: Web applications.
enriched_comment: A software application that runs on a web server and is accessed by users via a web browser. Also called web app, online application, browser-based application. Examples: Gmail, Google Docs, Facebook.
embedding_text: WebApplication (Thing > CreativeWork > SoftwareApplication): A software application that runs on a web server and is accessed by users via a web browser. Also called web app, online application, browser-based application.

label: WebContent
comment: WebContent is a type representing all [[WebPage]], [[WebSite]] and [[WebPageElement]] content. It is sometimes the case that detailed distinctions between Web pages, sites and their parts are not always important or obvious. The [[WebContent]] type makes it easier to describe Web-addressable content without requiring such distinctions to always be stated. (The intent is that the existing types [[WebPage]], [[WebSite]] and [[WebPageElement]] will eventually be declared as subtypes of [[WebContent]].)
enriched_comment: A general type representing any content accessible via the web, including web pages, websites, and their elements. Also called web content item, online content, digital web asset. Examples: a blog post, an entire website, an image embedded on a page.
embedding_text: WebContent (Thing > CreativeWork): A general type representing any content accessible via the web, including web pages, websites, and their elements. Also called web content item, online content, digital web asset.

label: WebPage
comment: A web page. Every web page is implicitly assumed to be declared to be of type WebPage, so the various properties about that webpage, such as breadcrumb may be used. We recommend explicit declaration if these properties are specified, but if they are found outside of an itemscope, they will be assumed to be about the page.
enriched_comment: A single document or resource accessible via a web browser, typically part of a larger website. Also called web document, HTML page, internet page. Examples: a product page on an e-commerce site, a news article page, a contact us page.
embedding_text: WebPage (Thing > CreativeWork): A single document or resource accessible via a web browser, typically part of a larger website. Also called web document, HTML page, internet page.

label: WebPageElement
comment: A web page element, like a table or an image.
enriched_comment: A distinct part or component within a web page. Also called page component, web element, UI element. Examples: a navigation menu, an image, a form, a table.
embedding_text: WebPageElement (Thing > CreativeWork): A distinct part or component within a web page. Also called page component, web element, UI element.

label: WebSite
comment: A WebSite is a set of related web pages and other items typically served from a single web domain and accessible via URLs.
enriched_comment: A collection of related web pages and other items, typically served from a single domain. Also called website, internet site, web presence. Examples: schema.org, Wikipedia, The New York Times website.
embedding_text: WebSite (Thing > CreativeWork): A collection of related web pages and other items, typically served from a single domain. Also called website, internet site, web presence.

label: WholesaleStore
comment: A wholesale store.
enriched_comment: A local business that sells goods in large quantities, typically to retailers or other businesses, rather than directly to individual consumers. Also called wholesaler, bulk store, cash and carry. Examples: Costco Business Center, a restaurant supply store, a building materials wholesaler.
embedding_text: WholesaleStore (Thing > Organization > LocalBusiness > Store): A local business that sells goods in large quantities, typically to retailers or other businesses, rather than directly to individual consumers. Also called wholesaler, bulk store, cash and carry.

label: WinAction
comment: The act of achieving victory in a competitive activity.
enriched_comment: The act of achieving victory or success in a competitive activity. Also called triumph, succeed, prevail. Examples: winning a race, winning a championship, winning an argument.
embedding_text: WinAction (Thing > Action > AchieveAction): The act of achieving victory or success in a competitive activity. Also called triumph, succeed, prevail.

label: Winery
comment: A winery.
enriched_comment: A local business that produces wine, often including facilities for grape cultivation, wine production, and tasting. Also called vineyard, wine producer, wine estate. Examples: Robert Mondavi Winery, a local family-owned vineyard, a wine tasting room.
embedding_text: Winery (Thing > Organization > LocalBusiness > FoodEstablishment): A local business that produces wine, often including facilities for grape cultivation, wine production, and tasting. Also called vineyard, wine producer, wine estate.

label: WorkBasedProgram
comment: A program with both an educational and employment component. Typically based at a workplace and structured around work-based learning, with the aim of instilling competencies related to an occupation. WorkBasedProgram is used to distinguish programs such as apprenticeships from school, college or other classroom based educational programs.
enriched_comment: An educational and employment program structured around work-based learning, aiming to develop occupational competencies. Also called apprenticeship, vocational training, on-the-job training. Examples: an electrician apprenticeship, a culinary arts internship, a software development bootcamp with practical projects.
embedding_text: WorkBasedProgram (Thing > Intangible > EducationalOccupationalProgram): An educational and employment program structured around work-based learning, aiming to develop occupational competencies. Also called apprenticeship, vocational training, on-the-job training.

label: WorkersUnion
comment: A Workers Union (also known as a Labor Union, Labour Union, or Trade Union) is an organization that promotes the interests of its worker members by collectively bargaining with management, organizing, and political lobbying.
enriched_comment: An organization that advocates for the interests of its worker members through collective bargaining and political lobbying. Also called labor union, trade union, industrial union. Examples: United Auto Workers (UAW), National Education Association (NEA), a local plumbers' union.
embedding_text: WorkersUnion (Thing > Organization): An organization that advocates for the interests of its worker members through collective bargaining and political lobbying. Also called labor union, trade union, industrial union.

label: WriteAction
comment: The act of authoring written creative content.
enriched_comment: The act of authoring or creating written creative content. Also called compose, pen, draft. Examples: writing a novel, composing an email, drafting a report.
embedding_text: WriteAction (Thing > Action > CreateAction): The act of authoring or creating written creative content. Also called compose, pen, draft.

label: XPathType
comment: Text representing an XPath (typically but not necessarily version 1.0).
enriched_comment: A data type representing an XPath expression, used for navigating XML or HTML documents. Also called XPath expression, XML Path Language, query path. Examples: "/bookstore/book[price>35]", "//title", "id('myElement')".
embedding_text: XPathType (Text): A data type representing an XPath expression, used for navigating XML or HTML documents. Also called XPath expression, XML Path Language, query path.

label: Zoo
comment: A zoo.
enriched_comment: A civic structure and facility where wild animals are housed, exhibited, and often bred for conservation and public education. Also called zoological garden, animal park, wildlife park. Examples: San Diego Zoo, London Zoo, Bronx Zoo.
embedding_text: Zoo (Thing > Place > CivicStructure): A civic structure and facility where wild animals are housed, exhibited, and often bred for conservation and public education. Also called zoological garden, animal park, wildlife park.
